U_0x006015: SThe wrecked <Chokijin> RyuOhKi, rebuilt as a humanoid mobile weapon with Grungust-series parts; it can't regain its old form. It keeps RyuOhKi's air and spell strengths, and its extending Nyoi Kinkobo staff covers melee.
U_0x0061E7:
One of the "Four Gods" <Chokijin> like RyuKoOh and KoRyuOh - semi-living weapons the ancients built to fight demons called "Hyakuja." It forms when JakuOhKi, the Suzaku <Chokijin>, combines with BuOhKi, the Genbu <Chokijin>.
Its slender Black Serpent Sword and Burinkou shield suit close-to-mid range. The sword, a chain of Jatorin segments, flexes, stretches, and even becomes BuJakuOh's Black Serpent Mortar - a feat of the Sofu, the talismans forming the Four Gods, enabling their transformations and combinations.
JakuBuOh is fierce and proud - female, in human terms. Scarred in past wars, its form changed often; Xia Nan and Tai Bei restored it near its true shape, adding Sofu parts based on a special humanoid weapon.
U_0x00674D:
One of the "Four Gods" <Chokijin> like RyuKoOh and KoRyuOh - semi-living weapons the ancients built to fight demons called "Hyakuja." It forms when JakuOhKi, the Suzaku <Chokijin>, combines with BuOhKi, the Genbu <Chokijin>.
The huge shell on its back and Shinju Shield barrier give it the Four Gods' highest defense, and its Sofu self-repair - the talismans forming a <Chokijin>'s body - far outstrips the others. It also bears Sofu parts based on a special humanoid weapon, including modern missile launchers. Its main arm, the Black Serpent Mortar from JakuBuOh's sword, suits bombardment; it can become the Genten Shoutenhou for ultra-long-range fire. Its mobility is low and melee is weak. BuJakuOh is calm, quiet, and patient.
U_0x006CB2: A Four Gods <Chokijin> modeled on Genbu. Defense is high but mobility low; its true role is shielding other units, and it fights poorly in this form.
U_0x014A35: A humanoid mobile weapon for ground and artillery combat, also called the Type 30. Slow but thickly armored, it's a stable, reliable machine that can also hover, giving excellent rough-terrain mobility. The Randgrith Raven is a modified Randgrith with a booster pod carrying a <Tesla Drive>, and two linear cannons for improved firepower.
U_0x014C8A:
A machine built by the Holy Kingdom of Langran in the subterranean world of <La Gias>. Blessed by wind spirit Cyfis, it's known as the "<Masoukishin> of the Wind." Its Fulcanelli perpetual engine requires the operator's (pilot's) <Prana> for peak efficiency; <Prana> is essentially "ki" or "aura," so output depends greatly on the operator's aptitude.
The airtight frame allows action underwater and in space, and a self-circulation system protects the operator on long sorties. Aether - massless energy at rest in absolute coordinates - serves as its magical propulsion medium. The Orichalconium armor, sealed at particle level with numerological wards, grants high magical defense.
Its Laplace Demon-type computer calculates causality to predict events, though this hinges on the operator's own magic. "Cybuster" is a guardian name against magical attack, not its true name.
U_0x0156CD: VThe Valsione, second Valsion-series unit, enhanced with <La Gias> alchemy. The ABMD system drives its frame and the DML system traces the pilot's motions, giving flexible, human-like movement no other humanoid weapon can match.
U_0x0158A0: SShu's anti-alien combat <Armored Module>. It runs on an antimatter engine, with armor of ultra-tensile titanium reinforced at particle level. Built for firepower and defense over mobility, its attack power is immense; co-designer Eric Wong said a pilot of superhuman ability could crush the world's forces in a day. Shu's Kabbalah program reportedly lets it use astral energy. It hides many black boxes, but since Shu went independent after the <DC War>, its sealed secrets remain a mystery.
